purpose: Final execution acceptance against approved criteria. This evidence does not mutate canonical plan or Task state.

acceptance_criteria: The same application build accepts two different project content configurations and presents each project's own material without project-name conditionals, copied frontends or a required live parent-depot service.
requirements.finding: One shared build serves the depot and alternate project; invalid optional ontology does not block alternate Home.

acceptance_criteria: The displayed project name and source references match that root. A missing or conflicting primary identity produces clear setup guidance; an optional adapter identity conflict affects that adapter without substituting another project's identity.
requirements.finding: Primary identity is root-bound; optional identity failure stays local.

acceptance_criteria: A reader can identify what the project does and who it is for from Home. Different projects receive substantively different explanations; undocumented purpose, scope or audience is identified as missing instead of invented.
requirements.finding: Root purpose, scope and audience are reviewed; alternate content differs and missing sections remain gaps.

acceptance_criteria: The first-step link resolves to an appropriate documented guide, entry document or current objective. Home explains the available Work, Project knowledge, status and help destinations without advertising unavailable actions.
requirements.finding: Start here resolves to the permitted README; destinations explain their reading purpose.

acceptance_criteria: Each displayed document link opens the correct permitted source or clearly explains its unavailability; the page does not expose an unrestricted directory listing.
requirements.finding: Permitted source handles open correct bounded text and reject arbitrary paths.

acceptance_criteria: Items identify the affected record, recorded issue or next step, source and observation time. The page distinguishes no recorded items from unavailable or partial coverage and invents no urgency, deadlines, risk score or app-owned attention ledger.
requirements.finding: Attention uses recorded issues/next steps, source status and observation time; partial coverage remains visible.

acceptance_criteria: Copy supplies necessary context, describes real actions, preserves source meaning and uncertainty, and avoids unsupported promotional claims. Errors explain the effect and a useful next step. Editorial review is a content inspection, not an AI-detector, voice or speech test.
requirements.finding: Home and help copy were inspected against their sources; errors describe effect and next step.

acceptance_criteria: Page loads do not generate prose or overwrite custom text. Supported provenance identifies the source bytes and reviewed output; changed sources mark affected copy for review. Missing copy uses a safe labeled excerpt/draft or an explicit gap. Content derived from a no-longer-permitted source is withheld.
requirements.finding: Reviewed text and source digests are checked; drift flags review and revoked source permissions withhold content.

acceptance_criteria: A reader can navigate between available views, return Home, use browser Back/Forward and follow source links. Controls have meaningful labels and visible keyboard focus, information does not rely on color alone, and normal text resizing or a narrow window does not hide essential content. Missing modules have clear states instead of misleading working links.
requirements.finding: Common navigation, Back/Forward, source links, keyboard focus, narrow layout and 125% text were observed.

acceptance_criteria: From Home, a reader reaches terms, documented processes, relationships and supporting sources within the common app experience. Existing distinctions between asserted, inferred, derived, external and historical information remain intact. Integration does not restore ontology authoring or create a permanent second copy of knowledge semantics.
requirements.finding: Existing Knowledge views run within the common shell and retain source classifications.

acceptance_criteria: Terms and processes remain readable when graph rendering is unavailable. Relationship labels and direction are understandable; owner-supplied limits or continuation are visible. Missing process details are identified rather than invented.
requirements.finding: Readable relationship lists and the map share directed/labeled data; unselected processes are explicit.

acceptance_criteria: Records retain their finding, applicability, evidence and recorded history or supersession. The app distinguishes remembered findings from current definitions or instructions, creates no second memory store, and explains unavailable memory access without blocking other knowledge views.
requirements.finding: Memory retains historical finding, applicability, evidence and lifecycle under its existing owner/corpus.

acceptance_criteria: A Task view preserves its recorded objective, state, current summary, next step, blockers and completion criteria, with related documents, history and evidence where recorded. Generated indexes do not override canonical records, and unmanaged or historical documents remain accurately labeled without migration or repair.
requirements.finding: Canonical Task fields and latest public response metadata are projected; bounded plan history remains separate.

acceptance_criteria: An approved TRD is labeled as document approval, not implemented work. An installed role or recorded assignment is not displayed as a running agent. Missing, failed, partial, stale and unexercised evidence retains that meaning; links between records require explicit references.
requirements.finding: TRD approval, plan state, static roles and runtime observations retain separate meanings.

acceptance_criteria: A reader can reach the supporting record and distinguish current observations from historical evidence. Unrecorded historical versions say Not recorded; a current digest is not presented as old verification evidence. Copied logical references contain no credentials and are not described as permanent live-service URLs.
requirements.finding: Source versions are current digests; unavailable history is labeled and copied references contain no bootstrap authority.

acceptance_criteria: Known IDs, titles and supported text can be found without semantic services. Results identify their type and source. The app reports failed, unsupported or partially scanned sources separately from no matches, does not widen memory's corpus, and excludes unapproved child-project and collaboration content.
requirements.finding: Bounded lexical search covers permitted owners and distinguishes partial/failed coverage from no matches.

acceptance_criteria: Installed, configured, disabled, incompatible, unavailable and not checked states remain distinguishable, as do static checks and runtime observations. A deliberately disabled optional feature is not presented as an emergency. Health uses existing owners and creates no new maintenance queue or repair loop.
requirements.finding: Health projects existing static configuration and recorded notices with disabled/unavailable/not-checked distinctions.

acceptance_criteria: Entries explain purpose, inputs, outputs and limits. Help covers starting/stopping the app, finding knowledge, understanding a blocked Task and resolving setup issues. A control that only copies an instruction says so; it does not claim to run a skill, start an agent or grant authority.
requirements.finding: Installed skills and roles expose purpose/inputs/outputs/limits; help and copy controls describe actual effects.

acceptance_criteria: The core page does not require an ontology snapshot, semantic backend, graph renderer or native agent session. Failed modules show bounded, intelligible limitations without erasing other results; reads respect existing owner limits. An invalid mandatory package or unsafe root binding produces setup guidance.
requirements.finding: Independent Home survives invalid optional knowledge; mandatory package/root failures have setup guidance.

acceptance_criteria: These operations do not create, close, resume or repair Tasks; approve documents; publish memory/ontology; acknowledge collaboration; rebuild governed indexes; or run maintenance. Only documented app-owned transient/session state and harmless presentation preferences may change.
requirements.finding: Reading leaves governed baseline bytes and modes unchanged; only documented transient state changes.

acceptance_criteria: The browser cannot select an arbitrary root or file, gain access through project registration, execute unknown project code during discovery, or expose unsupported collaboration metadata. Each optional integration remains confined to the selected project and its owner's permitted sources.
requirements.finding: Fixed root/source selection, no-follow reads, exact owner bindings and excluded collaboration/child content retain boundaries.

acceptance_criteria: Project content cannot execute as trusted app code, credentials do not enter ordinary copied links or diagnostics, and late or revoked responses cannot replace current permitted content. Changed routes/rendering use the same protections as the existing reader; no new broad security certification is implied.
requirements.finding: Literal rendering, revoked/late result rejection and unchanged Host/Origin/CSRF checks pass.

acceptance_criteria: A prepared project can use Home and available reading features without a remote service or live depot process. Launch does not run package installation/builds, download models, enable backends, apply Template updates or install a background service. Missing prerequisites produce guidance.
requirements.finding: Prepared local package starts without builds, installers, depot service or optional backends; setup fallback is static.

acceptance_criteria: On the initially supported macOS host, double-clicking the prepared project's launcher needs no typed command and resolves the project relative to that launcher. Reopening does not connect to another project or stop an unrelated process. If the required runtime/package is missing, local setup guidance remains readable without that runtime.
requirements.finding: The actual macOS launcher resolves this root and opens/reopens Home; missing-runtime guidance is an independent HTML asset.

acceptance_criteria: Tab closure makes no service-stop claim. Close reading session revokes that session; Stop app affects only the owned reader and explains the effect on its other tabs. Neither stops Tasks, agents, watchers or independent backends. Shutdown uncertainty is labeled honestly, package replacement requires restart, and no short reading-session timeout is added.
requirements.finding: Session revocation, authenticated same-project reopen and owned stop are distinct and observed.

acceptance_criteria: New-project setup can select the same reviewed package and bind the destination's own identity/content. Template starters contain no actual depot prose, Task history, memory records, grants, credentials or runtime state; setup does not claim that static installation proves a running app.
requirements.finding: Neutral Template and v14 setup distribute the same reviewed package without depot records or runtime state.

acceptance_criteria: Adoption identifies exact destinations and owned files, preserves customized prose/configuration and unrelated work, retains original setup editions, and records only the selected addition. Reruns do not overwrite later custom edits. Updates/recovery restore only operation-owned package/configuration changes, never older project history. Conflicts are reported through the existing owner.
requirements.finding: Selected additive adoption preserves old editions/custom content, refuses modified packages and checks frozen recovery.

acceptance_criteria: Adding Home and the shared app does not silently retire the existing reader entry point, break supported knowledge links, or revive retired authoring credentials/routes. Any approved replacement documents its actual alternative.
requirements.finding: Existing standalone Knowledge and CLI launch remain usable; app integration reuses existing read-only semantics.

acceptance_criteria: One result may cover multiple requirements. Content/configuration review and the existing build/static checks are preferred where sufficient, with a concise integrated browser smoke check for the changed user flow. Add or rerun a focused test only for an identified uncovered changed behavior, observed failure or material preservation/access risk; record that specific reason. There is no one-test-per-requirement rule or inherited 50-test release matrix.
requirements.finding: Checks are reused across requirements; focused reruns address concrete integration/history/layout/package risks.

acceptance_criteria: The planned and executed checks contain none of those campaigns. Ordinary readable markup, labels, keyboard use and layout remain product requirements, but no voice capability, assistive-technology certification or full WCAG conformance program is required. Unselected collaboration, management and depot modules do not gate completion.
requirements.finding: No voice, dedicated screen-reader, compatibility matrix, benchmark, stress or native-agent validation campaign ran.

acceptance_criteria: Instructions refer to real supported commands and identify the reviewed build and selected destinations. Verification distinguishes inspection/static checks from observed browser behavior and states unexercised limits. Reusable source, Template distribution, root adoption and existing-project adoption are reported separately; no extra testing is implied merely to fill a report.
requirements.finding: Build, commands, exact destinations, requirement/artifact traceability and unexercised limits are documented.

blocker: Existing locked frontend dependencies are missing; separate restore approval is pending.

execution_task_results.title: Freeze the selected implementation and preservation boundary
acceptance_criteria: The execution cites this exact plan revision and TRD revision 2, identifies its real writer, and names each selected destination and overwrite boundary.
The manifest distinguishes mandatory app package files from optional reader adapters and protects all existing governed records, custom text/configuration, unrelated changes and nonselected projects.
One verification map reuses existing evidence and names only changed behavior with an uncovered risk; it retains the exclusions in REQ-030.

execution_task_results.title: Define project identity and reviewed Home content
acceptance_criteria: Home has bounded purpose, scope, audience, Start here and permitted supporting links; empty source information remains a labeled gap.
Each reviewed content section binds its supporting source bytes and reviewed output; changed sources mark review need, revoked sources withhold derived text, and page loads never rewrite it.

The depot fallback reads only its self identity; a generic child does not need a live depot. Missing/conflicting primary identity gives setup guidance; neutral Template identity cannot run as the depot.

execution_task_results.title: Make the shared reader start independently of optional knowledge
acceptance_criteria: Project-app mode can serve Home and available modules with missing or invalid optional ontology configuration, and reports the affected adapter clearly.
The standalone ontology.py explore path retains its knowledge-first semantics and supported legacy routes.
New operations retain loopback, Host/Origin, session/request-token, safe error, bounded input, no-follow source and package-change checks. Reading writes only documented app transient state.

execution_task_results.title: Read canonical work and its explicit references
acceptance_criteria: Task details retain objective, lifecycle, current summary, next step, blockers, criteria, linked documents and recorded evidence; unmanaged/historical content is labeled.
Approval, implementation, recorded assignment, observed activity and release evidence remain distinct. Cross-record links use explicit references, never title similarity.
Unknown, incompatible, malformed or partially read owners yield bounded module limitations; generated indexes do not override canonical records and no mutation/repair is dispatched.

Project only permitted human-readable Work fields; remove unsupported collaboration fields, private native material and their counts before returning data. The read-only continue helper never becomes a browser resume action.

execution_task_results.title: Reuse knowledge and permitted memory readers
acceptance_criteria: Terms, documented processes, relationships and permitted sources use existing knowledge semantics, including asserted/inferred/derived/external/historical distinctions and continuation limits.
Memory findings retain applicability, supporting evidence and recorded history/supersession, remain separate from definitions, and use the memory owner corpus.
Missing memory or ontology access leaves other views available; no backend activation, acknowledgement, publication or data refresh mutation is invoked.

execution_task_results.title: Unify permitted source viewing and lexical search
acceptance_criteria: Known IDs, titles and supported permitted text are searchable without semantic services; results identify owner, type, source and observation/version information.
No matches, unavailable owner, unsupported content and partial scanning remain distinct; search does not widen the memory corpus or include unapproved child/collaboration material.

Source handles, counts, previews, copied logical references and cached responses enforce the same root/owner permission rules and current revocation checks; unknown historical versions say Not recorded.

execution_task_results.title: Read capability health and installed help
acceptance_criteria: Installed, configured, disabled, incompatible, unavailable and not checked remain distinct; static results are not relabeled runtime observations.
Health reuses existing owners/notices and creates no queue or repair loop; deliberately disabled optional modules remain ordinary states.
Skill and role help explains purpose, inputs, outputs and limits using supported installed metadata; a copy-instruction control says that it only copies.

execution_task_results.title: Add the common navigation and independent app context
acceptance_criteria: App navigation boots from primary project context independently of ontology and preserves browser Back/Forward, Home return and legacy knowledge links.
Missing modules have clear states; semantic controls, labels, focus and ordinary narrow-window/text-resize behavior keep essential content available.
Existing safe DOM construction, lazy graph loading and current-request/version guards apply to added views.

execution_task_results.title: Render project-owned Home explanations and next steps
acceptance_criteria: Home explains the selected project in concrete terms and links an appropriate documented first step, while incomplete source material remains an explicit gap.
Custom explanatory text remains stable across load/refresh; source changes show review need and revoked source-derived content is withheld.
Work/attention items retain record, actual issue/next step, source, observation and coverage states without invented urgency or scores.

execution_task_results.title: Render supporting reading views and traceable results
acceptance_criteria: A reader can follow explicit Work/requirement/plan/evidence references, search permitted material, inspect health and use accurate help without activating any owner mutation.
Knowledge remains readable without graph rendering and displays meaningful relationship labels, direction, continuation and missing process details.
Lessons remain labeled memory findings; status, source/version, observation time, historical gaps and optional failures retain their actual meanings.

execution_task_results.title: Provide the macOS launch and safe reopen entry
acceptance_criteria: Double-click on the initially supported macOS host needs no typed command and opens the selected launcher-relative project Home after readiness.
Missing Python or invalid package opens readable local setup guidance without depending on Python, npm, a cloud asset or a depot service.
Reopen validates ownership and exact compatibility; stale descriptors, reused PIDs and occupied ports never authorize connecting to another project or killing unrelated processes.

execution_task_results.title: Separate reading-session close from owned service stop
acceptance_criteria: Tab closure, explicit session revocation and owned service shutdown have distinct accurate effects; the UI explains effects on other tabs.
Stop cannot target Tasks, agents, watchers, independent backends or unrelated processes, and uncertain shutdown is reported honestly.
Package replacement requires restart, and late/revoked responses cannot restore content after close/stop.

execution_task_results.title: Build and publish one reviewed local runtime package
acceptance_criteria: One build supports Project-app and standalone Explorer modes and binds the exact source, schema, toolchain and local assets in the existing publication scheme.
Runtime launch does not install/build or fetch remote assets; incomplete and changed packages fail with bounded guidance.
The recorded static/build result is reused for distribution and final verification; rerun only when material source changes invalidate it.

execution_task_results.title: Prepare neutral app starters and Template mappings
acceptance_criteria: The exact distribution preview selects the complete reviewed package and neutral project-app.json, Launch Project.command and Project App Setup.html from reusable sources for the registered Template.
Starter content contains no depot explanation, actual history/records, grants, credentials or runtime state; static-ready installation makes no running-app claim.
Only exact owned destinations are updated; watcher coordination, current input checks, mode metadata and conflict/recovery behavior remain under the existing updater.

execution_task_results.title: Add selected initializer adoption with preservation
acceptance_criteria: Create and first prepare-existing use current Template assets; selected earlier completed projects retain their base receipt edition and add only the named app module.

Unchanged owned package updates, new executable launcher mode and private content provenance have exact source/destination receipts; customized/incomplete/conflicting packages are preserved and reported.
Reruns preserve later custom text/configuration, same-operation recovery checks frozen inputs, and rollback restores only operation-owned package/configuration changes.
The supported beneath-Projects destination boundary remains intact; root adoption is separate and no runtime, backend, Task or service is started.

execution_task_results.title: Adopt the reviewed app into the selected depot root
acceptance_criteria: The real destination and exact reviewed file set are named before adoption; package, schema and required guard bindings are coherent and selected root preimages are retained.
Root Home content explains the depot from inspected sources and retains meaningful source/review metadata; it is absent from neutral sources.
The root is not passed to the child-project initializer; nonselected products, project registry semantics, existing governed records and customized settings remain preserved.
Standalone Explorer launch remains available; setup/static checks do not claim browser operation.

execution_task_results.title: Check reuse and only uncovered changed risks
acceptance_criteria: The same build presents a distinct synthetic project identity/purpose with no ontology snapshot or live depot dependency, without repeating the full main browser journey.
Neutral starter and custom-copy/rerun preservation are evidenced with the smallest applicable fixture; shared owner coverage is referenced rather than duplicated.

Each added or rerun focused check states its uncovered changed risk, such as source revocation, safe rendering, stale responses, owned shutdown or executable-mode/adoption handling; unchanged controls reuse applicable evidence.
No voice/screen-reader/certification, compatibility matrix, benchmark/stress, native-agent pilot or exhaustive optional-feature campaign is run.

execution_task_results.title: Observe one integrated browser journey
acceptance_criteria: Actual launch opens the correct Home without a typed command, reopen targets its owned service, navigation/history and representative permitted content/source links work, and required controls are understandable.
Relationship text remains usable without reliance on the graph; Lessons and decisions and any unavailable adapters are truthfully labeled.
Closing a reading session and stopping the owned app show their real effects, retained existing Explorer access is checked concisely, and only documented transient state changes.
The result records actual host/browser/package, observed steps and exact limitations, with no unsupported certification or broad runtime claim.

execution_task_results.title: Record actual delivery and complete the final audit
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-001 through REQ-031 maps to delivered artifacts and sufficient current evidence, or an explicit unresolved failure that prevents a false completion claim; every changed artifact has a requirement basis.
Instructions describe real supported commands and the reviewed build; reusable source, neutral Template, root adoption and synthetic existing-project support are reported separately.
Final inspection follows current evidence and affirmatively records each protected-path preservation result, current registry, plan/Task state separation and exact implementation limits.
No Git/publication/deployment, unselected real-product adoption, cross-platform claim or historical full-release completion is inferred; stop after the scoped criteria are met.

canonical_state.task_execution: Native goal with bounded implementation workers; no canonical Task activation.
